main_visual_task: The coffee becomes the hero cup - amber stream, milk crown and swirl, then the barista sets the cup into the window light and steps out of frame, leaving a held product hero composition.

user_script_review.note: 「日出开门」有人版8镜方案获用户批准（飞书）

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same real barista seen full-length exactly once, charcoal linen apron over a plain white shirt with short dark hair, natural human proportions with five fingers per hand; the same unlabeled pour-over set plus one white ceramic cup filled with dark espresso and cold milk; no branding anywhere
prompt_bible.environment_lock: the same small modern city cafe now in full morning light, wooden window counter, rain-fresh glass, soft blue city outside, no other people inside or outside
prompt_bible.material_lock: real human skin with visible pores and micro-texture, real linen and cotton fabric weave, real crema marbling, cream threads, glass and ceramic surfaces, physically plausible splashes and steam ribbons
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: hard warm sunrise key from upper left with a fixed cool blue fill from the window
prompt_bible.palette_lock: deep espresso brown, morning gold, cool window blue, charcoal linen gray, cream white
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm commercial cinematography on a real cinema camera, true-to-life photographic rendering, natural skin subsurface scattering, practical light falloff, filmic contrast, shallow macro depth of field
prompt_bible.screen_direction: energy travels left-to-right across cuts; the cup ends centered; label areas remain blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: diegetic rhythm only: pour finish, milk splash, soft cup landing, final steam hiss; no voice and no dialogue

internal_shots.visual_state: dark amber coffee streams from the brewer into the white ceramic cup
internal_shots.subject_action: the stream fills the cup with rising crema as the barista's hand sets the brewer down and slides out of frame
internal_shots.camera_action: locked close-up on the filling cup
internal_shots.focus: amber stream and the rising crema line
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key refracts through the stream into liquid gold
internal_shots.end_state: the cup stands full with the hand fully out of frame

camera_plan.motivation: bank the transformation and remove the human in one gesture
camera_plan.start_position: close-up level with the cup rim
camera_plan.path: camera remains locked on the filling cup
camera_plan.focus_transition: falling stream to rising crema line
camera_plan.axis_lock: stream falls center while the hand exits right
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the hand fully leaves the frame

internal_shots.visual_state: one cold milk drop crowns on the dark espresso and cream threads swirl into a golden-brown nebula
internal_shots.subject_action: the crown collapses into rings that merge into a slow marble galaxy
internal_shots.camera_action: one slow push-in toward the swirl center
internal_shots.focus: crown edge then the galaxy core
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunrise key warps into liquid caustics inside the swirl
internal_shots.end_state: the swirl settles near-still with one last thread

camera_plan.motivation: make the cup a small universe worth entering
camera_plan.start_position: macro level just above the cup rim
camera_plan.path: push straight down toward the swirl core
camera_plan.speed_curve: slow constant push with gentle ease-out
camera_plan.focus_transition: crown peak to cream threads to galaxy core
camera_plan.end_position: extreme macro on the settled swirl core
camera_plan.axis_lock: push vertically only while the swirl rotates clockwise
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the core turns near-still

internal_shots.visual_state: the barista, full-length for the first time, carries the finished cup to the window counter in full sunrise light
internal_shots.subject_action: the cup lands softly on the counter; the barista gives one closed-mouth smile and turns away out of frame
internal_shots.camera_action: one smooth pull back as the person exits, keeping the cup central
internal_shots.focus: cup in the barista's hands, then the cup alone on the counter
internal_shots.lighting_state: full morning sun floods the counter with the cool city beyond the glass
internal_shots.end_state: the frame holds the lit cup with the barista gone

camera_plan.motivation: the human hands over the spotlight to the product
camera_plan.start_position: medium framing following the cup at counter height
camera_plan.path: pull straight back along the window axis as the person steps out
camera_plan.speed_curve: smooth medium pull with steady ease
camera_plan.focus_transition: cup in hands to cup on counter to empty space
camera_plan.end_position: medium wide on the counter with the cup centered
camera_plan.axis_lock: cup stays centered while the person exits frame left
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut once the person fully clears the frame

internal_shots.visual_state: final hero - the white cup with marbled crema centered on the lit counter, bean jar and brewer flanking, steam curling upward
internal_shots.subject_action: one last steam ribbon rises and dissolves while the crema marbling holds
internal_shots.camera_action: locked hero framing that stays perfectly still through the final hold
internal_shots.focus: crema marbling and the steam silhouette
internal_shots.lighting_state: balanced sunrise key and cool fill with a gentle highlight bloom
internal_shots.end_state: a clean brand-ready hero frame with steam still curling and no person visible

camera_plan.motivation: resolve the journey into a single readable product image
camera_plan.start_position: medium wide centered on the cup
camera_plan.path: camera locked in place while only the steam moves
camera_plan.focus_transition: crema marbling to the rising steam
camera_plan.axis_lock: cup stays centered and vertical with nothing drifting
camera_plan.stop_condition: hold the still frame for the final one and a half seconds

first_frame: close-up of dark amber coffee streaming into the white ceramic cup
last_frame: held hero frame of the marbled coffee cup centered in window light with bean jar and brewer flanking, no person visible
